    c_custkey as customer_key,
    c_name as customer_name,
    c_address as address,
    c_phone as phone,
    c_nationkey as nation_key,
    c_mktsegment as market_segment,
    cast(c_acctbal as decimal(15,2)) as account_balance
from {{ source('raw', 'customer') }}
patch.explanation: The stg_customers model failed contract validation because column account_balance was defined as DECIMAL(15,2) but the source raw.customer.c_acctbal is VARCHAR. Profiling shows the conversion to DECIMAL(15,2) is lossless (0 conversion errors, correct decimal places). Adding an explicit cast resolves the contract mismatch and all checks now pass.
